capabilities: Create typed campaign notes (NPC, Session, Adventure Log, Location, PC, Table) from a YAML config
Organize new notes into per-type campaign subfolders with frontmatter fields
Roll weighted random tables defined in azer-table code blocks
Insert backlink tables sorted by Azer note type
Generate random tables and session recaps via the Anthropic API
extras: AI features are billed to the user's own Anthropic account; the README details exactly what data is sent (only on command) and that the API key is stored per-device outside the vault.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to define typed campaign note types with automatic organization, or to roll weighted dice tables inside notes.

relations.evidence: The two AI commands — Generate table (AI) and Recap recent sessions (AI) — call the Anthropic API with your own key.

summary: TTRPG note toolkit that creates typed campaign notes (NPCs, sessions, locations), rolls weighted random dice tables, and generates AI session recaps.
